monitoring_enabled.description: Enable or disable the ARC monitor subsystem globally.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file where monitor events are written.

max_cache_entries.description: Maximum number of monitoring state entries to retain in cache.

update_interval.description: Interval in seconds between periodic updates of the monitoring data.

monitoring_services.description: List of services to monitor. Each service defines its own monitoring behavior.

endpoint.description: URL or host:port endpoint to check for this service.

enabled.description: Whether this service’s monitoring is active.

interval.description: Override interval (in seconds) for checking this specific service. If omitted, defaults to the global update_interval.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this service provides.

retry_max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts after a failed monitoring request.

retry_delay.description: Delay in seconds between retry attempts.
